# Extension APIs of Wren

The `chrome.*` namespaces an extension context gets, generated from `api/ext_*.widl` (docs/extensions.md, section 3.9).
The same description produces the host's method table and argument decoders (`src/page/ext_api_generated.odin`),
the constants of `chrome.*` and the conformance cases (`src/page/ext_api_generated_test.odin`).

* A namespace or a member exists in a context only when the manifest has its permission, the kind of context is
  listed, and the manifest has an `action` when it needs one. A call outside these rules fails in the host too.
* A method returns a promise. With a function as its last argument, it calls it with the result instead, and sets
  `chrome.runtime.lastError` during that call when it failed. `browser.*` (Firefox flavour) has promises only.
* Arguments are matched to the signature as in Chrome: an optional parameter is left out when the argument in its
  place does not have its type. A wrong type, a missing property or a value out of bounds is an error that names
  the parameter and the property.
* Status `host`: the browser answers. Status `realm`: the context answers itself, without the browser's loop.
